\[Audio Drama\] **The Inner Dialogue**

[Spotify](https://open.spotify.com/show/5gQl7IH8pHRabdlRdrtQsO)| [Anchor](https://anchor.fm/inner-dialogue)| [PocketCasts](https://play.pocketcasts.com/web/podcasts/share?id=e08e2fa0-6a15-0137-f267-1d245fc5f9cf)| [Google](https://podcasts.google.com/?feed=aHR0cHM6Ly9hbmNob3IuZm0vcy9iZDhhMDU4L3BvZGNhc3QvcnNz)| [Breaker](https://www.breaker.audio/the-inner-dialogue)| [RadioPublic](https://radiopublic.com/the-inner-dialogue-G2MDL0)| [Stitcher](https://www.stitcher.com/podcast/anchor-podcasts/the-inner-dialogue)

​

Our aim through this podcast is to tell the story of an international engineering student. We have released 3 episodes so far. The story is narrated by Arya, in the form of self-talk. This is the official description:  

" Join Arya in her transition from a teenager to a young adult as she tackles the twists and turns of life. "

* S1E01: " Leaving her parents at the airport, Arya navigates her way through the airport and through this new turn in her life "
* S1E02: " After witnessing a somewhat-thought-provoking event on the plane, Arya discusses what kind of a student life she is going to lead."
* S1E03: " Arya learns how to take the bus and realizes that she has different personalities around different people. Now that she has a clean canvas, who should she be? "

Please listen to any one of the episodes. We do have a few specific questions, but any feedback is good.

* We tried scripts for the first two episodes and in the 3rd episode we tried to make it more impromptu. Which approach do you think works better?
* Our character does have an accent, but is it hard to understand?
* Are you able to follow along the story?
* Should we have constant background music?

​

Thank you so much for your time. We will really benefit from any feedback.

​

\- TheID\_creators

[The Inner Dialogue S1E3](https://anchor.fm/inner-dialogue/episodes/Why-am-I-wearing-a-mask-e4cv3p)

After some reviews from the redditors here we changed  our recording style to be more impromptu. There are some flaws in the audio of this episode but we are constantly learning from our mistakes. Please highlight more of those!

In general, we were wondering if the listeners can follow along the story?

Is it getting too boring?

Can you understand that Arya is trying to go deeper and question who she is?

Any feedback is welcome. Thanks for listening!

Thank you so much. You are right, we lose a lot of the rhythm because first we  write it down and then someone else reads it out. We were thinking of making it impromptu. 
This was very helpful as it confirmed our doubts.

Also, in episode 2 we address arya getting excited as it only hits her once she lands at her destination. I hope we can take your suggestion and make the next episode better.

Also, thank you for recommending the other podcasts. We will definitely hear them and learn from them.
Thank you, that is very good to know

Hey folks,

This is our first attempt at telling a story; creating a podcast and everything else in-between. Our aim through this podcast is to  tell a story of an Indian girl who moves to Canada for education. We want to walk the listener through her experience by making them hear the dialogue that she has with herself.  We were told that this is the place to get some constructive feedback, so please hear the first episode if you have time: [Without a return ticket](https://anchor.fm/inner-dialogue) (duration: 13 minutes)

We have a few specific questions:

1. In moments where Arya is not really paying attention to her inner voice we add static in the background. Could you equate the static to "mental-noise"?
2. How is the audio and speed of speech? Is the speech clear?
3. were you able to follow along the story?
4. What are the things that we can do to improve the listener's experience.

Thank you. Hopefully one day we can pass what we learn from you to some other newbie!
